tools.description: Prepare a change to the user's connected account as a DRY RUN: nothing is written. ALWAYS show the diff and any guardrail flags to the user and get their go-ahead before calling apply_action. Types and params (app = a linked App Store id or package name, locale like en-US): review.reply {app, review_id, text} (review ids from read_connection what=reviews; Play replies ≤ 350 chars); listing.update {app, locale, fields: {name|title, subtitle, description, promotional_text, whats_new, marketing_url, support_url, privacy_policy_url}} (Play: title, short_description, full_description, video); keywords.set {app, locale, keywords: [..] or 'a,b,c', mode?: replace|add|remove} (App Store, 100 bytes comma-joined); screenshots.upload {app, locale, display_type: APP_IPHONE_67… (asc) or image_type: phoneScreenshots… (play), images: [{url}], replace?}; ads.keyword.bid {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{id, bid?, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED}], max_increase?}; ads.keyword.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{text, match_type?: EXACT|BROAD, bid?}]}; ads.negative.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id?, keywords: [{text, match_type?}]} (Apple Ads ids from read_connection what=ads).
